$comment: Projection registry for derived-projection-consistency-validator. A generated region is a control artifact ONLY if its file is registered here and the fact id is declared for that file. Registering a fact also makes its region MANDATORY: deleting the region fails the gate. Coverage is closed in BOTH directions - every marker-bearing file discovered on disk must appear either in `projections` or in `exclusions`, so an unregistered projection cannot exist silently (see docs/agent/FAILURES.md F008, REC-CONTROL-SELF-EXEMPTION).

exclusions.reason: Documentation that explains the marker convention and therefore quotes it. Prose about the mechanism is not a claim about the repository. Excluding it explicitly is what lets the document describe the mechanism accurately instead of being reworded to satisfy it - the F006 failure.
